transcript.en: Hello, everyone. Thanks for attending tonight’s event.
transcript.zh: 大家好。谢谢大家参加今晚的活动。

transcript.en: Let me start with the early history of our charity, Eyesaver.
transcript.zh: 让我从我们的慈善机构眼睛拯救者的早期历史说起。

transcript.en: Eyesaver was founded by a retired optometrist Timothy Gaines.
transcript.zh: 眼睛拯救者由退休的验光师蒂莫西·盖恩斯 创立。

transcript.en: I have spent much of my working life at Eyesaver.
transcript.zh: 我的大部分工作生涯都在眼睛拯救者度过。

transcript.en: I am 60 years old now and I started working for this organization 15 years ago when I left a corporate position to help people with eye problems. Now, our charity has been helping people for three decades.
transcript.zh: 我现在已经 60 岁了，15 年前我离开了一个公司，来到了这个机构帮助有眼部问题的人。现在，我们的慈善机构已经帮助人们三十年了。

transcript.en: You may know that we are now doing various other things to help people with eye problems.
transcript.zh: 大家可能知道我们现在正在做各种各样的事情去帮助有眼部问题的人。

transcript.en: That includes medications for children with eye diseases and operational help to those in the public who have eye problems.
transcript.zh: 包括为患有眼疾的儿童提供药物，以及为有眼疾的人们提供手术帮助。

transcript.en: But when Mr. Gaines just founded Eyesaver, he wanted the program to be able to offer common eye equipment to those who needed it.
transcript.zh: 但是当盖恩斯先生刚刚创立眼睛拯救者时，他原是希望该项目能够为有需要的人提供常见的眼科设备。

transcript.en: We receive occasional donations from corporations and charity groups.
transcript.zh: 我们偶尔会收到来自企业和慈善团体的捐款。

transcript.en: Now we have over 1500 volunteers who work on the streets with the little red donation boxes which many of you are familiar with, and this is the main source of funding for us.
transcript.zh: 现在我们有1500多名志愿者带着大家熟悉的红色小捐款箱走上街头，这是我们的主要资金来源。

transcript.en: Besides, we are planning to work to secure donations from wealthy benefactors.
transcript.zh: 此外，我们正计划争取富裕的慈善家的捐款。

transcript.en: Many people are passionate about charity cause and have been inquiring how to donate money to us.
transcript.zh: 很多人都热衷于慈善事业，一直在询问如何捐款给我们。

transcript.en: I really appreciate that. But our main need is to collect glasses for our patients.
transcript.zh: 我感到非常感谢。但我们的主要需求是为我们的病人收集眼镜。

transcript.en: Many of you have multiple pairs of old glasses in your possession and we encourage you to gather these pairs which you no longer need and donate them to our cause.
transcript.zh: 你们中的许多人都拥有多副旧眼镜，我们鼓励您收集这些不再需要的眼镜并将它们捐赠给我们机构。

transcript.en: In doing this, you’ll be able to make sure that someone else can see better.
transcript.zh: 这样做，您可以确保其他人看得更清楚。

transcript.en: Most of us cannot imagine a life in which we are unable to see well.
transcript.zh: 我们大多数人都无法想象无法看清的生活。

transcript.en: This is why your eyeglass donations are so critical to our mission.
transcript.zh: 这就是为什么您捐赠眼镜对我们的使命如此重要。

transcript.en: And, as a side note, we offer full-time positions, let me know if you are interested.
transcript.zh: 另外，我们提供全职职位，如果您有兴趣，请告诉我。

transcript.en: Our goal is to make people aware that even the smallest of donations can help change a person’s life.
transcript.zh: 我们的目标是让人们意识到即使是最小的捐款也可以帮助改变一个人的生活。

transcript.en: So, your donation can be a turning point for them.
transcript.zh: 所以，您的捐款可以成为他们的转折点。

transcript.en: The other day, when I was talking to some people on the street, they were surprised to find out how easily some eye problems can be cured.
transcript.zh: 前几天，我在街上和一些人交谈时，他们惊讶地发现有些眼部问题是很容易治愈的。

transcript.en: And I’m proud to say that our next program will aim at educating people about common eye diseases, we are able to prevent many fatal eye problems.
transcript.zh: 我很自豪地说，我们的下一个计划旨在教育人们了解常见的眼部疾病，我们能够预防许多致命的眼部问题。

transcript.en: In order to publicize our charity program, we surely need to do some advertising.
transcript.zh: 为了宣传我们的慈善项目，我们肯定需要做一些广告。

transcript.en: When we first started our program, we used computers to create awareness for our cause.
transcript.zh: 我们第一次开始我们的项目时，使用电脑来让人们了解我们的事业。

transcript.en: For instance, promoting seminars in which we informed people as to how they could help us to solve eye problems.
transcript.zh: 例如，推广研讨会，让人们了解他们可以如何做，以帮助我们解决眼部问题。

transcript.en: But in recent years, the main means of advertising our program is through audio recordings.
transcript.zh: 但近年来，我们节目的主要宣传方式是通过录音。

transcript.en: We have found it cost-efficient and effective.
transcript.zh: 我们发现这样做省钱并有效。

transcript.en: It’s good to know that many of our staff are recommending our program to their friends and colleagues, but I am afraid that our training cannot show people the whole picture of our program.
transcript.zh: 很高兴知道我们的许多员工都在向他们的朋友和同事推荐我们的课程，但恐怕我们的培训无法向人们展示我们课程的全貌。

transcript.en: Finally, I would like to tell you about some organizations which have played important roles in the development and success of Eyesaver.
transcript.zh: 最后，我想介绍一些在眼睛拯救者的发展和成功中发挥重要作用的组织。

transcript.en: Our affiliation with the National Vision Funding Group has allowed us to gain fame and to become even more significant.
transcript.zh: 我们与国家愿景基金集团的合作让我们声名鹊起，变得更有意义。

transcript.en: So, many people around the country are coming for our services.
transcript.zh: 所以，全国很多人都来寻求我们的服务。

transcript.en: Our association with the Eye for the Future organization has allowed us to run cooperative ads by which we seek producers of equipment to work with us.
transcript.zh: 我们与“未来之眼”组织的合作使我们能够投放合作广告，通过这些广告我们寻求设备生产商与我们合作。

transcript.en: Meanwhile some of our staff has been sent to this organization for some special training, their skills should be improved very soon.
transcript.zh: 同时我们的一些员工已经被派到这个组织进行了一些特殊的培训，他们的技能应该很快就会提高。

transcript.en: Also, we have had a longtime cooperation with Sam’s Eyecare Institution.
transcript.zh: 另外，我们和山姆眼科也有长期的合作。

transcript.en: Our relationship with it has given us the opportunity to link with many different academic institutions, including colleges and universities with good reputation.
transcript.zh: 我们与山姆眼科的合作关系使得我们有机会与许多不同的学术机构建立联系，包括声誉良好的学院和大学。

transcript.en: And we have a similar friendship with a group called Youth Health.
transcript.zh: 我们和一个叫青少年健康的团体也有类似的合作友谊。

transcript.en: Our connection with that group allows us to link directly with young kids since this is a crucial stage in their growth.
transcript.zh: 我们与该群体的联系使我们能够直接与年幼的孩子联系，这是孩子们成长的关键阶段。

transcript.en: We plan to contact with some colleges and hope that with their help, more college students could get to know our program.
transcript.zh: 我们计划联系一些大学，希望在他们的帮助下，让更多的大学生了解我们的项目。

transcript.en: So, as you can see, we have all bases covered in linking with students, as we have affiliations directly with both administrators and the students themselves.
transcript.zh: 所以，正如大家所看到的，我们拥有与学生联系的所有基础，因为我们与管理者和学生本身都有直接的联系。

transcript.en: Thank you so much for your attention today.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢大家今天的关注。

transcript.en: As we try to stamp out eye problems, we will appreciate your donations, no matter how large or how small.
transcript.zh: 当我们努力解决眼部问题时，我们感谢您的捐赠，无论多少。

transcript.en: We believe with our efforts, the world will be a brighter and more beautiful...
transcript.zh: 我们相信，通过我们的努力，世界会变得更加光明和美好...
